LOCK IN · Warehouse Loading Training That Plays Like a Game
Source: https://trailer-load.com/  ·  Made by F-Keys Creative LLC (Operations President: Vince Gonzalez)

=== WHAT IT IS ===
LOCK IN is a free, browser-based warehouse trailer-loading training simulator. Pieces ride in on a belt; you stack them into a trailer wall that has to physically hold up. It plays like a puzzle game but models real freight-loading: support and balance, load integrity, locking complete rows into shelves, hazmat placed low, fragiles boxed in on both sides, non-conveyables staged, dead air stuffed inside tires, and a dispatch clock counting down. Every wall is scored on integrity, density, pace, and safety, and ranked from Rookie to Yard Legend.

It runs in any browser with no install and no login required. Gameplay is always free. There are no player accounts. Public boards take three initials. A player's results reach an instructor only after the player joins that instructor's crew with its join code, then a name and 4-digit PIN or a personal code the instructor issued.

=== HOW IT WORKS ===
1. Build the wall · Select freight, place it, rotate it. Floor-up, support underneath, no floating boxes. The physics won't let you cheat gravity.
2. Load it right · Lock shelves, keep the center of gravity centered, box fragiles in on both sides, keep hazmat below the waist line, and stuff dead air inside tires.
3. Get your grade · Every wall is scored on integrity, density, pace, and safety, then ranked from Rookie to Yard Legend.

Modes: Training (a trainer builds a full wall one placement at a time, with the reason for every move, then you sign off), Trailer-Load (the flagship: wall after wall at full tempo, chasing a personal best and a world rank), Daily (one shared deterministic wall for everyone on Earth, resetting 00:00 UTC).

Companion mini-game: Smalls Sort (https://trailer-load.com/ss/) · sorting and stacking small parcels, testing speed and accuracy on the smalls line.

=== BUSINESS MODEL: FREE FOR WORKERS, A LICENSE FOR FACILITIES ===
The game is free forever. What schools and employers pay for is the program license: crews without the 9-person limit, the CSV export, a data agreement and support. Player data is never sold.

Workers play free:
- Full game, every mechanic, no paywall.
- No player account: three initials on the boards, nothing else leaves the device without a crew.
- Nothing about play is sent unless you join an instructor's crew.

Instructors get the metrics:
- The instructor dashboard: each crew member's loading performance. A crew of up to 9 is free; a license removes the limit and adds CSV export.
- Load integrity (attention to detail), completed walls (follow-through), throughput (pieces per hour), and safety incidents · the numbers managers already track · per crew member, with CSV export on a license.
- Built for CTE programs, trade and technical schools, and warehouse operations teams. Perkins-eligible: a software license is an allowable local use of Perkins V funds under Sec. 135(b)(5)(D); the state CTE agency makes the final call.
- An instructor signs up on the dashboard; F-Keys Creative LLC applies a license to a program's crews when it buys one.

Who it's for: CTE high-school programs, trade and technical schools, warehouse and dock operations teams, logistics employers, workforce-readiness programs.

=== IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER ===
Training supplement only. LOCK IN builds intuition and tracks practice progress. It does NOT replace employer safety training, OSHA training, or any certification requirement.
